llm.summary: The skill's requests and instructions are coherent with its stated purpose: it reads the conversation and writes structured memory/topic files; it does not ask for unrelated credentials or install anything.

dimensions.detail: Name/description (extract memories into memory/topics/ and update MEMORY.md) match the declared runtime actions: reading dialogue context and writing topic files and an index. No unrelated env vars, binaries, or config paths are requested.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md confines actions to analyzing recent dialogue and writing topic files with frontmatter under memory/topics/ and appending MEMORY.md. It explicitly forbids saving code paths, git history, debugging recipes, or other unrelated data. It does not instruct reading other system files or sending data to external endpoints.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Instruction-only skill with no install spec and no code files — lowest-risk footprint (nothing is downloaded or written by an installer).
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: No environment variables or external credentials are requested. The required permissions (FileRead, FileWrite/FileEdit for memory/ and optional sessions_spawn) are proportionate to the stated functionality.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill is not force-installed (always:false). It describes automatic/triggered runs after each conversation and optionally requests sessions_spawn (forking a child agent). Autonomous invocation + file-write is expected for this functionality, but sessions_spawn increases capability surface (it can start a child agent).
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears to do what it says: extract salient points from conversations and write them under memory/topics/ and append an index. Before enabling it, confirm: 1) the agent is sandboxed so the skill cannot write outside the intended memory/ directory; 2) you are comfortable with automatic background extraction after every conversation (you can prefer manual /extract-memories if not); 3) you are aware the skill optionally requests sessions_spawn (which can fork child agents) — if you don't want that, disable or deny that permission. Consider asking for a preview step before files are written, or run the skill with manual trigger initially to inspect produced files.
